researchMetadata.councilMethod: Single-agent simulated eight-perspective review; not independent human or agent votes

council.finding: Use primary domain sources plus supplied sample patterns; no vendor marketing or secondary citation treated as causal proof.
council.resolution: Field/value evidence distinguishes documented use from exact-phrase experimentation.

council.finding: Listing, campaign and editorial goals should not share promotional-copy assumptions.
council.resolution: Use case and copy policy remain separate with channel-scoped errors.

council.finding: Surface/environment, framing/viewpoint, light quality/direction and finish/color are distinct decisions.
council.resolution: Separate fields prevent overloaded adjectives and expose interactions.

council.finding: Accurate labels and campaign typography may need editing outside generation.
council.resolution: Reserve-only mode and preserved physical labels distinguished from added copy.

council.finding: Shared vocabulary does not justify identical hierarchy for every task.
council.resolution: Ten independently ordered profiles and task clauses; deterministic substitution and no model tuning fields.

council.finding: Thirty fields can overwhelm a novice.
council.resolution: Propose one selection step followed by grouped native controls: identity/use case first, preset-relevant fields next, advanced groups collapsed. All values remain inspectable; no hidden creative defaults.

council.finding: MVP count and persistence contracts conflict with research expansion.
council.resolution: Architecture changes explicitly pending; no project baseline silently revised.

council.finding: Studio hero and reflective still life can look similar if only adjectives differ.
council.resolution: Viewer task, material-first hierarchy and highlight-readability criteria distinguish P08; color-only candidate rejected.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Save a customized P04 with no sourcePresetId, then reload.
adversarialReview.impact: A derived/default compiler can lose the detail-first hierarchy.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Enter copy with double spaces and a line break in reserve-only mode.
adversarialReview.impact: Generic whitespace normalization changes copy; generic approved-copy wording may request rendering.
adversarialReview.correction: Preserve exact content and use policy-specific declarative clause variants.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Select any built-in and Generate without describing a product.
adversarialReview.correction: All built-ins leave subject blank; required-field error.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Change P09 track environment to a studio alcove.
adversarialReview.impact: Hardcoded task prose could restore track after editing.
adversarialReview.correction: No default scene values in fixed profile prose; only current placeholders.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Choose P08 for a matte product without changing material emphasis.
adversarialReview.impact: Contradictory material intent could create gloss.
adversarialReview.correction: User guidance to choose actual finish; material clause forbids inventing a different finish. Arbitrary semantic contradictions require review.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Use overhead arrangement with a deliberately oblique custom camera view.
adversarialReview.impact: A creative configuration could be incorrectly blocked.
adversarialReview.correction: Only exact curated combinations warn; custom semantics not guessed. Warning never rewrites input.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Present the same field list as a proven high-performing image system.
adversarialReview.impact: Documented usage is mistaken for causal effectiveness.
adversarialReview.correction: Explicit no image-test status on every profile/value; no invented performance scores.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Show all thirty controls in a single flat form.
adversarialReview.correction: Grouped progressive disclosure recommended with complete inspectability.

adversarialReview.reproducibleExample: Prefix user wording No invented details with Avoid these additions.
adversarialReview.impact: Double-negative phrasing can obscure the requested constraint.
adversarialReview.correction: Use neutral Additional constraints prefix, preserving current literal user wording.

product-description.whatItIs: Thông tin về vật thể hoặc bộ sản phẩm cần xuất hiện. Đây là đầu vào chính xác định subject, không phải mô tả phong cách.
product-description.whenToUse: Luôn nhập trước khi Generate; đây là identity của sản phẩm hoặc inventory của bộ.
product-description.howToUse: Ghi category, hình dáng, màu, chất liệu và các chi tiết biết chắc. Với bundle, liệt kê từng món và số lượng. Chỉ ghi thương hiệu hoặc label khi đã được cung cấp.
examples: A fictional matte ivory lotion bottle with a rounded charcoal pump and an unprinted body.
product-description.wordingPattern: {product-description}: A fictional matte ivory lotion bottle with a rounded charcoal pump and an unprinted body.
commonMistakes: Không dùng “a premium product” thay cho mô tả; không đoán thành phần hoặc SKU.
product-description.validationBoundaries: String up to 1200 characters; no unsafe control characters. Required.
starterSuggestions: A fictional matte ivory lotion bottle with a rounded charcoal pump and an unprinted body.
evidence: S01: Product intake / Product design lock

reference-notes.whatItIs: Chỉ dẫn ảnh nào làm product reference, style reference hoặc composition reference và phần nào được dùng.
reference-notes.whenToUse: Nhập khi dùng external reference; giúp phân biệt identity, style và composition roles.
reference-notes.howToUse: Đặt tên vai trò rõ ràng, ví dụ image 1 = exact product. Nêu phạm vi như không suy đoán mặt sau. Không cần nhập URL để dùng field này.
examples: Image 1 will be attached externally as the product identity reference; use only visible front and side details.
reference-notes.wordingPattern: {reference-notes}: Image 1 will be attached externally as the product identity reference; use only visible front and side details.
commonMistakes: Không trộn style reference với identity reference; không tuyên bố website đã đọc ảnh.
reference-notes.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.
starterSuggestions: Image 1 will be attached externally as the product identity reference; use only visible front and side details.

preserve-details.whatItIs: Các thuộc tính phải giữ khi đổi scene hoặc style: silhouette, màu, tỷ lệ, logo, chữ hoặc phụ kiện đã xác nhận.
preserve-details.whenToUse: Nhập khi cần bảo toàn form, màu, chữ hoặc các chi tiết quan trọng đã biết.
preserve-details.howToUse: Liệt kê những chi tiết quan trọng và có nguồn. Dùng mô tả cụ thể như rounded pump hoặc exact label spelling; tránh lời hứa perfect accuracy.
examples: Keep the ivory body, charcoal pump, rounded shoulder and unprinted body unchanged.
preserve-details.wordingPattern: {preserve-details}: Keep the ivory body, charcoal pump, rounded shoulder and unprinted body unchanged.
commonMistakes: Không yêu cầu giữ nguyên màu rồi nhập palette đổi màu sản phẩm. Engraving và logo chưa thấy không được tự thêm.
preserve-details.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.
starterSuggestions: Keep the ivory body, charcoal pump, rounded shoulder and unprinted body unchanged.

audience.whatItIs: Người xem mà creative hướng tới. Audience giúp chọn bối cảnh và mức độ thông tin, không thay đổi identity sản phẩm.
audience.whenToUse: Dùng khi bạn biết nhóm viewer và context liên quan; không cần đoán audience.
audience.howToUse: Mô tả nhóm người và ngữ cảnh sử dụng có liên quan. Để trống nếu chưa biết; không gán stereotype về hành vi hoặc sở thích.
examples: People comparing compact desk accessories
commonMistakes: Không suy diễn demographic từ hình dáng sản phẩm; không biến audience thành performance claim.
audience.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.

props.whatItIs: Vật hỗ trợ story, scale hoặc styling nhưng không phải sản phẩm được bán.
props.whenToUse: Dùng khi cần styling element ngoài những món được bán; để trống nếu không cần.
props.howToUse: Ghi tên props và vị trí hoặc vai trò. Phân biệt included bundle contents với styling props trong Product description. Để trống khi không cần props.
examples: A folded neutral towel behind the bottle, not included in the product
props.wordingPattern: {props}: A folded neutral towel behind the bottle, not included in the product
commonMistakes: Không thêm món khiến khách tưởng thuộc bộ sản phẩm. Với Google primary listing, tránh props ngoài bundle.
props.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.
starterSuggestions: A folded neutral towel behind the bottle, not included in the product

interaction-action.whatItIs: Điều người hoặc vật đang làm với sản phẩm, hoặc action cue trong một ảnh tĩnh.
interaction-action.whenToUse: Dùng cho thao tác bàn tay, interaction hoặc action cue trong một still image.
interaction-action.howToUse: Ghi một hành động cụ thể với contact/hand position rõ. Với dynamic still, nêu freeze-frame cue thay vì shot sequence hoặc video script.
examples: A hand holds the bottle beside a familiar notebook; fingers leave the product unobstructed.
interaction-action.wordingPattern: {interaction-action}: A hand holds the bottle beside a familiar notebook; fingers leave the product unobstructed.
commonMistakes: Không thêm products vào person-only reference; trong Product workflow, subject vẫn là supplied product.
interaction-action.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.
starterSuggestions: A hand holds the bottle beside a familiar notebook; fingers leave the product unobstructed.

detail-target.whatItIs: Bộ phận cần xem kỹ trong macro hoặc detail image.
detail-target.whenToUse: Nhập khi muốn inspect một feature; đặc biệt hữu ích cho macro hoặc tight crop.
detail-target.howToUse: Ghi khu vực có evidence: seam, pump, engraving hoặc finish. Ghép với Shot size và Focus treatment, không tự thay angle.
examples: The join between the pump head and bottle shoulder
detail-target.wordingPattern: {detail-target}: The join between the pump head and bottle shoulder
commonMistakes: Không crop tới detail chưa thấy hoặc invented construction. Không biến material detail thành performance claim.
detail-target.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.
starterSuggestions: The join between the pump head and bottle shoulder

scale-cue.whatItIs: Vật hoặc ngữ cảnh so sánh kích thước tương đối để viewer hiểu product scale.
scale-cue.whenToUse: Dùng khi cần quan hệ kích thước tương đối; không dùng làm bằng chứng đo chính xác.
scale-cue.howToUse: Dùng familiar object hoặc measured relation biết chắc. Nếu chỉ concept, ghi approximate contextual scale; không thêm số đo chưa có.
examples: Approximate contextual scale beside an ordinary hand; not a measured size claim.
scale-cue.wordingPattern: {scale-cue}: Approximate contextual scale beside an ordinary hand; not a measured size claim.
commonMistakes: Tỷ lệ trong generation có thể sai. Khi catalogue cần kích thước chính xác, cần reference/số đo và kiểm tra output.
scale-cue.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.
starterSuggestions: Approximate contextual scale beside an ordinary hand; not a measured size claim.

exact-copy.whatItIs: Chữ được user cung cấp để render hoặc ghi chú cho layout sau. Compiler không sáng tác headline, giá hoặc offer.
exact-copy.whenToUse: Bắt buộc khi Render supplied copy; tùy chọn cho note hậu kỳ; không nhập khi No added copy.
exact-copy.howToUse: Nhập đúng spelling/punctuation. Giữ intentional whitespace; chỉ chuẩn hóa line endings. Render mode sẽ giữ text; reserve mode đánh dấu copy dành cho post-production.
examples: A SIMPLE DAILY RITUAL
commonMistakes: Không tự dịch hoặc thêm CTA. Chữ trên label vật lý nên ghi trong Preserve details; exact typography phải review.
exact-copy.validationBoundaries: String up to 240 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.

exclusions.whatItIs: Những thứ không được thêm hoặc cần tránh trong generated image. Được viết bằng ngôn ngữ tự nhiên, không phải negative_prompt API.
exclusions.whenToUse: Dùng khi có những lỗi hoặc additions cần tránh; để trống nếu không có constraint bổ sung.
exclusions.howToUse: Ghi các rủi ro có liên quan: invented logo, extra products, watermark hoặc distorted hands. Dùng constraints cụ thể và tránh phủ định quá rộng.
examples: No invented logos, extra products, added watermark or altered product geometry.
exclusions.wordingPattern: {exclusions}: No invented logos, extra products, added watermark or altered product geometry.
commonMistakes: Không dùng “no text” nếu label cần giữ; không kỳ vọng negative wording là bộ lọc chắc chắn.
exclusions.validationBoundaries: String up to 800 characters; no unsafe control characters. Optional unless a dependency makes it required.
starterSuggestions: No invented logos, extra products, added watermark or altered product geometry.

compilerContract.status: Proposed declarative contract; not yet implemented in site

input.templateProfileId: An explicit valid product profile or product-neutral-mold
input.values: Map of the 30 known field IDs to strings; absent optional keys normalize to blank

steps: Validate workflow, profile identity and compiler version; unknown identities do not silently fall back.

Reject unknown keys and non-string inputs. Normalize ordinary fields using NFC and collapsed whitespace. Exact copy preserves Unicode composition and spacing; only CRLF/CR become LF and all-whitespace becomes blank.
Validate length by Unicode scalar-value count, not UTF-16 code units. Reject C0 controls except tab/LF and reject DEL.
Validate required fields and fixed-choice values. Suggested choices accept custom text, replacing rather than appending the chosen suggestion.
Run deterministic error/warning rules; errors retain editor configuration and block output. Warnings do not rewrite values.
Use the explicitly selected profile order. Include each nonblank field once, omit its whole clause when blank, and omit empty sections. Use copy-policy clause variants.
Substitute each trusted mold placeholder once using a callback; never interpret inserted user braces as variables. Escape Markdown structural characters.
Serialize exact-copy as a quoted JSON string to represent spacing/newlines unambiguously; do not translate its content.
Return deterministic Markdown text, normalized values and issues. Never read DOM, storage, clock, random state or a remote model.
compilerContract.outputFormat: Balanced English Markdown; fixed heading, ordered sections, supplied-fact safeguard. No StyleMode or model-specific control assumed.

normalization.ordinary: NFC + trim + whitespace collapse; preserve case and wording
normalization.exactCopy: Preserve content and interior/edge spacing; CRLF/CR -> LF; no NFC rewriting

identityPersistence.recommended: Add templateProfileId inside ProductPromptConfig as compiler metadata, not a creative field. Retain existing compilerVersion on SavedConfiguration and immutable versioned profile registry.
identityPersistence.why: sourcePresetId is provenance; it may be absent after custom save and must not become profile identity by implication.

alternatives.reason: Provenance can be absent or misleading for saved/custom/remixed configurations.
A user edit would unpredictably change instruction hierarchy.
Stable across save, load, remix and overrides.

identityPersistence.migration: Existing product records without identity use an explicit neutral migration after documented review; preserve generatedPrompt/editedPrompt and old compilerVersion. Unknown versions/profile IDs block regeneration until migration is selected.
identityPersistence.saveLoadRemix: Persist and copy metadata unchanged on save/load/remix; sourcePresetId remains provenance only.
identityPersistence.profileSwitch: Only explicit preset/profile selection changes hierarchy; editing fields never selects a new mold.

compilerContract.manualPromptEdits: Keep editedPrompt separate. Regenerate asks before overwriting an existing edit; cancellation preserves both configuration and edited text. Compiler cannot itself show a dialog.
compilerContract.immutability: Published profile version is immutable; changes require compiler/profile version and change register. Generated outputs can be retained for audit.

saveLoadRemix.recommended: Add templateProfileId inside ProductPromptConfig as compiler metadata, not a creative field. Retain existing compilerVersion on SavedConfiguration and immutable versioned profile registry.
saveLoadRemix.why: sourcePresetId is provenance; it may be absent after custom save and must not become profile identity by implication.

alternatives.reason: Provenance can be absent or misleading for saved/custom/remixed configurations.
A user edit would unpredictably change instruction hierarchy.
Stable across save, load, remix and overrides.

saveLoadRemix.migration: Existing product records without identity use an explicit neutral migration after documented review; preserve generatedPrompt/editedPrompt and old compilerVersion. Unknown versions/profile IDs block regeneration until migration is selected.
saveLoadRemix.saveLoadRemix: Persist and copy metadata unchanged on save/load/remix; sourcePresetId remains provenance only.
saveLoadRemix.profileSwitch: Only explicit preset/profile selection changes hierarchy; editing fields never selects a new mold.

overrideBehavior.manualEdits: Keep editedPrompt separate. Regenerate asks before overwriting an existing edit; cancellation preserves both configuration and edited text. Compiler cannot itself show a dialog.

contextExcerpts: - **Control exists at multiple levels**: text prompts, generation parameters (aspect ratio, seed, guidance scale, steps), and reference inputs (images for style, character, composition). Each layer adds controllability but also complexity. [developers.openai](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/articles/what_is_new_with_dalle_3)

Parameters like `guidance_scale` or `seed` are not interchangeable across models. [developers.openai](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/articles/what_is_new_with_dalle_3)

contextExcerpts: - **Product imagery demands material-aware prompting**: Glass, metal, matte, and textured surfaces require different lighting language. - **Workflow structure beats prompt verbosity**: A six-slot prompt structure (subject, surface, lighting, composition, mood, style) outperforms long adjective lists. Structured prompts are reusable templates, not one-offs. [promer](https://promer.ai/blog/ai-product-photography-prompts)
